test_case_name: Accept all cookies and verify banner closure on branch search page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the branch search page
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible on the branch search page

test_case_name: Access cookie options from parent to child and verify navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' on the parent page
And then check that the cookie options page is displayed on the branch search page

test_case_name: Navigate to branch search via 'Scopri il conto' and verify page load

intents.intent: Click 'Scopri il conto' on the parent page
And then check that the branch search page is displayed

test_case_name: Perform desktop search on branch search page and verify results

intents.intent: Type $name in the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' field on the branch search page
Click the 'Cerca (desktop)' button on the branch search page
And then check that the search results are displayed on the branch search page

test_case_name: Reset desktop search field on branch search page and verify field is cleared

Click the 'Reset ricerca (desktop)' button on the branch search page
And then check that the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' field is cleared on the branch search page

test_case_name: Perform mobile search on branch search page and verify results

test_case_name: Login as guest on branch search page with remember me option and verify login

intents.intent: Type $email in the 'E-mail' field on the branch search page
Type $password in the 'Password' field on the branch search page
Click the 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox on the branch search page
Click 'ENTRA' on the branch search page
And then check that the user is logged in as a guest on the branch search page
